lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
educai-admin: 441 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B.
educai-personal: 441 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 441 B.
educai-main: 555 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 555 B.
All 4 pages load the same 1 file: 787,137 B raw, 216,049 B gzip, 91.4 % of the smallest page (educai-main, 860,907 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/dialogs 107,161 B, @nextcloud/vue 24,108 B, dompurify 20,469 B, @vue/reactivity 17,728 B, semver 8,909 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 24,298 B on the educai-admin page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (31 packages, 718 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
